subject: PROPAGATE directive
notes: { ON | OFF } with ON un-underlined, so a bare >>PROPAGATE selects ON; 7.3.21.4 GR4's OFF default is about omitting the DIRECTIVE, not about which alternative the format implies. Any other operand is COBOL1911 (kb/Work PB794 retired this directive's own COBOL0883). The runtime propagation SEMANTICS are separate rows and remain PHASE-13 residue; this row is the format.
